The net balance for 'acme' is 23070 cents. Now I will record the payout for 'acme'. Then I will proceed to 'birch'.
The payout for 'acme' was successful. Next, I need to get the net balance for 'birch'.
The net balance for 'birch' is 27412 cents. Now I will record the payout for 'birch'. Then I will proceed to 'cobalt'.
The payout for 'birch' was successful. Finally, I need to get the net balance for 'cobalt'.
The net balance for 'cobalt' is 48443 cents. Now I will record the payout for 'cobalt'. After this, all payouts will be recorded, and I will finalize the task.
All payouts have been recorded for acme, birch, and cobalt. I will now finalize the task by reporting the payouts made.
